topology.CORE1: Trusted root for VLANs 10,20,99 at base priority 8192; Gi0/24 to SW1
topology.SW1: Gi0/24 root-facing trunk; Gi0/23 initially shut designated downlink to EDGE1; protect only Gi0/23 with Root Guard
topology.EDGE1: Gi0/24 to SW1; priority 32768 normally, test VLAN 10 at 4096
topology.Trunks: VLANs 10,20,99; native 99; no PortFast or BPDU Guard; PCs need no gateways

checks: Root Guard practice is independent and safely staged with zero tasks, fixed host addresses and no gateways
published setup allows inferior BPDUs, elects CORE1 and forwards both VLAN pairs on a designated protected trunk
a real superior VLAN 10 BPDU blocks the protected STP instance without err-disabling the physical trunk or changing the protected root
Root Guard drops real traffic in both VLAN 10 directions while both VLAN 20 directions continue over the same trunk
restoring only the downstream priority automatically recovers the protected path and retains the observed incident
without Root Guard the same superior downstream bridge can take the root even while all traffic still works
inferior BPDUs continue to be accepted when the downstream priority is increased further
configured Root Guard and a superior peer cannot earn blocking credit without actual BPDU delivery
disabling protection is not a valid recovery and re-enabling it blocks the still-superior peer again
resetting the physical interface cannot resolve a continuing superior-root advertisement
Root Guard evaluates VLANs independently when both are attacked and one priority is repaired first
published show commands expose ROOT_Inc, a live connected trunk and no err-disabled interface, then all verification commands succeed after recovery
completed references and portable saves retain a genuinely observed incident while elections rebuild and live protection remains required
imported Root Guard observations are bounded and never award a configured-only incident
scope: Adds a staged Root Guard catalog lab and bounded lesson criteria for explicit Root Guard settings and observed per-VLAN blocking. Uses the existing IOS CLI, received-BPDU STP and packet-forwarding engines without modifying networking commands or protocol behavior. The completed reference executes the real setup, superior-priority incident and downstream-priority recovery. No fabricated incident or traffic credit, backend dependency or live CML validation is claimed.
verificationNotes: The native VLAN also has an explicit trusted CORE1 priority, so an incidental default-priority MAC tie cannot block the legitimate trunk independently of the staged VLAN 10 incident.
Root-inconsistent is displayed as Desg BKN* with *ROOT_Inc. The physical interface remains up; show interfaces status err-disabled must omit the protected trunk.

The browser tests used a frozen offline build. Its SHA-256 matches final index.html and dist/index.html byte for byte. All eight Root Guard browser checks and seven general catalog checks passed, with no page errors or external requests; the general catalog regression ran after the final production build.
